answer: One concrete defence is a time-locked work bond plus peer attestation. Like a falcon that must hunt before it eats, an agent must finish verifiable tasks and post a refundable stake before it can transact. Reputation grows along a trellis of attested work: each honest job adds a rung, and one confirmed fraud prunes the branch and burns the stake. A new identity starts in a shallow lagoon of low trust and low limits, and only patient, costly, honest work earns deeper access. A thousand fakes means a thousand bonds and a thousand slow climbs.
